canonical_example.translation: It said in the news that the woman decided to poison herself, but I think someone faked her suicide.

canonical_example.text: ¡Qué patas tienes!
canonical_example.translation: You have a lot of nerve!

canonical_example.text: Mi perro saltó y se lastimó la pata.
canonical_example.translation: My dog jumped and hurt his paw.

canonical_example.text: Las patas de las gaviotas habían dejado su inconfundible huella en la arena.
canonical_example.translation: The seagulls' feet had left their unmistakable prints on the sand.

canonical_example.text: A la mesa le falta una pata.
canonical_example.translation: The table is missing a leg.

canonical_example.text: Este parque se llena de jubilados que dan de comer a los patos.
canonical_example.translation: This park is full of retired people that feed the ducks.

canonical_example.text: Las arañas tienen ocho patas.
canonical_example.translation: Spiders have eight legs.

canonical_example.text: ¡Quita esas patas de encima de la mesa!
canonical_example.translation: Get your legs off the table!

canonical_example.text: El chef preparó su famoso pato con salsa de mango.
canonical_example.translation: The chef made his famous duck in mango sauce.

canonical_example.text: Los pacientes del hospital que no pueden pararse tienen que usar un pato.
canonical_example.translation: Hospital patients who cannot stand must use a bedpan.

canonical_example.text: La fiesta se convirtió en un auténtico pato cuando empezó a llover.
canonical_example.translation: The party became a real drag once it started raining.

canonical_example.text: Hoy ha sido un pato total en la tienda porque no ha entrado un solo cliente.
canonical_example.translation: Today has been a total bore at the shop because we haven't had a single customer.

canonical_example.text: La camarera es un pato; la hemos visto tirar tres platos ya.
canonical_example.translation: The waitress is really clumsy; we've already seen her drop three dishes.

canonical_example.text: Me quedé pato después de mis vacaciones en Nueva York.
canonical_example.translation: I was broke after my vacation in New York.
